_about: Blessings shown when the disk is mended (and sent with the notification that it broke). 'dated' gives a text for a particular night (YYYY-MM-DD, the date the disk broke); any other night takes one from 'pool', the same for everyone on that date. Edit, then npm run deploy.
pool: May the eye that looks at you with envy turn its gaze to its own garden.
May your door stay open to friends and closed to trouble.
May your bread be warm and your table never empty.
May every road you take lead you safely home.
May the light in your house never go out.
May your worries scatter like shards and your joys hold together like gold.
May your hands find good work and your heart find rest.
May the rain come to your fields when they are thirsty.
May those you love be near, and those who are far be well.
May what was broken in you mend stronger than before.
May your words be sweet and your silence be kind.
May luck sit at your table like an old friend.
May your nights be quiet and your mornings bright.
May the wind at your back be gentle and the one in your face be brief.
May your children laugh in the house you built.
May a good word find you before noon.
May the evil eye pass you by like a cloud over a mountain.
May your steps be light and your burden lighter.
May your well never run dry.
May your guests leave happier than they came.
May patience walk beside you and haste stay behind.
May your tea be hot and your company warm.
May the cracks in your day be filled with gold.
May you be loved for what you are, not for what you have.
May the stars keep watch over your sleep.
May every ending you meet be the start of something good.
May your heart be as clear as glass and as strong as the sea.
May the blue eye keep you, and may you never need it.
May your garden bloom in the season you planted it for.
May today give you one reason to smile and no reason to frown.
